prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a low-speed head-on collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1405; do not mention it.)
text:
I am writing to advise that this office now represents the injured party in connection with the motor vehicle collision referenced above. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter, including any contact with our client, to this office. Our client has been advised not to discuss the claim or give any statement to your company or its representatives.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability limits and any other applicable coverage available under the policy issued to your insured, together with a certified copy of the declarations page. Given the nature of the impact, we also ask that you confirm the insurer will preserve all evidence relating to the collision, including vehicle data, photographs, repair and inspection records, witness statements, recorded communications, and any telematics or event data recorder information.

Our client sustained injuries in a low-speed head-on collision, and we anticipate that medical treatment and related losses will continue. Please acknowledge receipt of this letter and confirm your claim number and assigned adjuster within fourteen days.
